operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a single attendance log by id. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The trailing path segment (`1`) is the **data level** — how deeply related records are loaded — not a page or format flag. For this endpoint it has no visible effect, so `/attendance_log/{id}` and `/attendance_log/{id}/1` return the same result.

The successful response is a **flat object** of the attendance log's fields (it is not wrapped in a `data` envelope).

`status` is one of:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| draft | Draft |
| sign_in | Sign In |
| sign_out | Sign Out |
| repeated_sign_in | Repeated Sign In |
| repeated_sign_out | Repeated Sign Out |
| invalid | Invalid |
| unknown_employee | Unknown Employee |

`source_type`, when present, is one of `machine`, `supervisor`, `file`, `self`.

Note: requesting an id that does not exist currently returns HTTP 500 with the plain-text body `error happened` rather than a 404.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the attendance log to fetch.

200.description: The attendance log, returned as a flat object.

schema.description: A single attendance-log record, returned flat (not wrapped).

staff_id.description: Id of the employee the log belongs to.

session_id.description: Id of the attendance session, when applicable.

status.description:
Log status.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| draft | Draft |
| sign_in | Sign In |
| sign_out | Sign Out |
| repeated_sign_in | Repeated Sign In |
| repeated_sign_out | Repeated Sign Out |
| invalid | Invalid |
| unknown_employee | Unknown Employee |

source_id.description: Id of the source that produced the log, when applicable.

source_name.description: Name of the source, when applicable.

source_type.description:
Source of the log.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| machine | Machine |
| supervisor | Supervisor |
| file | File |
| self | Self |

source_method.description: How the source recorded the log, when applicable.

invalidity_reason.description:
Why the log is invalid, when applicable.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| weekend | Weekend |
| on_leave | On Leave |
| no_shift | No Shift Assigned |
| out_of_shift_boundaries | Out of Shift Boundaries |

401.description: Authentication or authorization failed. A missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token returns a plain `401` (no JSON body). An authenticated caller who lacks permission to view attendance logs receives `{ "error": "You are not allowed to view this page" }`.

500.description: Requesting an id that does not exist currently returns HTTP 500 with the plain-text body `error happened`.

schema.description: Plain-text body `error happened`. Currently returned when the requested id does not exist (rather than a 404).
